description: The core Runeblade identity — combining arcane power with physical combat through Etched Runes.

skills.name: Etch Rune
skills.description: Sketch a rune in the air, applying one Etched Rune buff to yourself. On your next physical hit all Etched Runes detonate dealing bonus magic damage each, then are consumed.
skills.ai_instruction: Apply one Etched Rune status to actor. Duration 10 rounds, persists false. Each Etched Rune adds +(Willpower modifier) magic damage to the next physical attack. All Etched Runes detonate simultaneously on hit and are consumed. Call apply_status with effect='etched_rune', duration=10, persists=false.

skills.name: Runic Strike
skills.description: A powerful strike infused with arcane energy, dealing both physical and magic damage.
skills.ai_instruction: Make a physical attack roll (1d20 + Strength modifier) vs target AC. On hit deal weapon dice + Strength modifier physical damage. Additionally deal 1d10 + Willpower modifier magic damage (1d20 + Willpower modifier vs magic defense). Call apply_damage for combined total. On crit either component: max die + roll + modifier for that component.

skills.name: Arcane Parry
skills.description: Channel arcane energy into a defensive ward, adding your Willpower modifier to AC until the start of your next turn.
skills.ai_instruction: Apply Arcane Parry status to actor. Adds Willpower modifier to AC until start of actor's next turn. Call apply_status with effect='arcane_parry', duration=1, persists=false.

skills.name: Runic Empowerment
skills.description: Your Etch Rune now applies Enhanced Runes that also bolster your defenses until detonated.
skills.ai_instruction: Apply one Enhanced Rune status to actor instead of a basic Etched Rune. Duration 10 rounds, persists false. Enhanced Rune adds +(Willpower modifier) magic damage to next physical hit AND adds Willpower modifier to AC until detonated. All Enhanced Runes detonate on hit and are consumed. Call apply_status with effect='enhanced_rune', duration=10, persists=false.

skills.name: Arcane Momentum
skills.description: Passive. After detonating runes this turn your next attack costs 1 less AP. Once per turn.
skills.ai_instruction: Passive skill. After actor detonates any runes this turn, apply Arcane Momentum status (duration 1, persists false). While Arcane Momentum is active reduce AP cost of actor's next attack by 1 (minimum 0). Consume Arcane Momentum after the discounted attack. Once per turn only.

skills.name: Runic Overload
skills.description: Detonate all current runes as a burst of pure magic energy without needing a physical attack. Guaranteed hit.
skills.ai_instruction: No attack roll needed. Count all Etched Rune and Enhanced Rune stacks on actor. Deal (Willpower modifier) magic damage per rune stack as a guaranteed hit. Call apply_damage with total damage. Consume all rune stacks after. If no runes are stacked the skill fizzles — narrate the attempt with no damage.
